steps.adaptation: The implementation is confined to the toy model's weighted-mid equivalence. It does not estimate the paper's full Markov-chain distant-future micro-price or reproduce the empirical price-prediction comparison.
steps.paper_rule: The weighted mid-price equals I times the best ask plus (1-I) times the best bid, where I is best bid size divided by total best-quote size. Under the stated Brownian-imbalance toy model, the micro-price equals this weighted mid-price.
steps.runtime_rule: Compute best-bid-size weighted ask plus best-ask-size weighted bid, then compare with last trade price.
